tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background (oat). Every page sits on this.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, inputs, drawers, modals, dashboard panels.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Alternating section bands, table header rows, code and quote wells.

tokens.name: surface-sage
tokens.usage: Tinted bands: 'How it works', membership, the consultation CTA band.

tokens.name: surface-clay
tokens.usage: Warm tinted band: free guide opt-in, testimonials. Use once or twice per page.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: Footer and the closing 'Book a consultation' band. Text on it is ink-inverse.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and body text on every surface-* token.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, meta lines, helper text on every surface-* token.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Placeholder text and disabled labels on surface and surface-raised only (4.5:1). Never for content.

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on surface-inverse.

tokens.name: ink-inverse-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on surface-inverse (footer links, legal line).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers, card borders, table rules. Decorative: never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input, checkbox, radio and switch borders (3:1 on surface and surface-raised).

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Sage green. Primary buttons ('Book a consultation'), links, active nav, selected states, progress fills.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of primary fills and links.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary and primary-hover fills.

tokens.name: primary-soft
tokens.usage: Selected row, chosen time slot, soft badge fill. Text on it is primary-ink.

tokens.name: primary-ink
tokens.usage: Text on primary-soft and surface-sage (badges, selected slot label).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Clay. Eyebrows, highlighted words in headlines, the free-guide CTA, sale price. Never for errors.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover of accent fills.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on accent fills.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Clay badge fill ('New', 'Free guide'). Text on it is accent-ink.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Text on accent-soft and surface-clay.

tokens.name: honey
tokens.usage: Decorative only: star ratings, cover blocks, illustration fills. Never text.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Paid, Active, Completed, Verified. Always with a check icon or word.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Success badge and notice fill; text on it is success.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Past due, Expiring soon, Pending, Cancelling. With an icon or word.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Warning badge and notice fill; text on it is warning.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, Failed, Revoked, destructive buttons. With an icon or word, never colour alone.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on danger fills (Delete account, Cancel subscription confirm).

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Error notice and badge fill; text on it is danger.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral information: Trialing, Pre-order, medical disclaimer notice.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Info notice and badge fill; text on it is info.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset, on every interactive element. 3:1 on all surfaces.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind modals, the cart drawer and the plan picker.

families.display: "Newsreader", "Noto Naskh Arabic", "Noto Serif Bengali", Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif
families.sans: "Figtree", "IBM Plex Sans Arabic", "Noto Sans Bengali", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif
